speed_mph: # SOURCE: EMFAC2025 v2.1.1 (CARB), Statewide CA, CY2026, Annual, avg-speed bins.
# VEHICLE MAPPING: gas_suv = EMFAC "MDV" (8,501-14,000 lb GVWR), Gasoline.
#                  diesel_heavy_truck = EMFAC "T7 Tractor Class 8" (combination tractor, Class 8), Diesel.
# RATIONALE: ResiFlow FAF freight / T29 / NewT0 HT are combination-unit (5+ axle), not single-unit Class 6. Replaces prior diesel_su_truck (T6 Instate Delivery Class 6).
# CALC: gal/mi = Fuel Consumption (1000 gal/day) * 1000 / CVMT (mi/day).
# CAVEATS: CA fleet (CARB standards); EMFAC2025 not EPA-approved for SIP.
#          T7 Tractor Class 8 may lack some high-speed bins — blank cells left blank (do not invent).
# CROSS-CHECK mean gal/mi: T6 SU Class6 diesel=0.1230; T7 Class8 fleet VMT-wtd=0.1742.
